description: This file defines the Borders class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, managing border styles for spreadsheet cells, including individual borders, pseudo-borders, and related properties. It provides methods to apply styles, retrieve specific borders, and handle conditional styling logic.

classes.name: Borders
classes.description: Manages the border styles of spreadsheet cells, including individual borders for sides and pseudo-borders for more complex styling scenarios.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Borders object, optionally configured as a supervisor with pseudo-borders.

methods.name: getSharedComponent
methods.description: Retrieves the shared style component for the current cell for supervisor style inheritance.

methods.name: getStyleArray
methods.description: Builds an array representing the style configuration from given subcomponents.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies style settings from an input array to the borders or pseudo-borders.

methods.name: getAllBorders
methods.description: Returns the pseudo-border representing all borders, only for supervisors.

methods.name: getOutline
methods.description: Returns the outline pseudo-border, only for supervisors.

methods.name: getInside
methods.description: Returns the inside pseudo-border, only for supervisors.

methods.name: getVertical
methods.description: Returns the vertical pseudo-border, only for supervisors.

methods.name: getHorizontal
methods.description: Returns the horizontal pseudo-border, only for supervisors.

methods.name: getDiagonalDirection
methods.description: Gets the diagonal direction of the border.

methods.name: setDiagonalDirection
methods.description: Sets the diagonal direction of the border.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the border style.
